description: This Java source file defines the HL7Util class, providing utility methods for parsing HL7 timestamps and times, handling timezone offsets, and retrieving HL7 archive directory paths within the OpenMRS healthcare platform.

classes.name: HL7Util
classes.description: Utility class for handling HL7 timestamp and time parsing, timezone handling, and directory retrieval related to HL7 message processing in OpenMRS.

methods.name: parseHL7Timestamp
methods.description: Converts an HL7 timestamp string with varying levels of precision into a java.util.Date object, filling in defaults for missing components.

methods.name: parseHL7Date
methods.description: Convenience method for parsing HL7 date strings (year, month, day).

methods.name: parseHL7Time
methods.description: Converts an HL7 time string into a java.util.Date object set to the specified time, with date component set to epoch.

methods.name: getHl7ArchivesDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the directory path for HL7 archives, using a global property or defaulting to a predefined directory.
